Ita kuti huchokwadi hwechiso kuti uvhure otomatiki kiyi yako yekupinda kana KWallet paunopinda. Izvi zvinochengetedza password yako yakavharwa muTPM kana iripo, kana yakavharidzirwa ne AES-256-GCM uchishandisa midzi-chete master kiyi. Face auth set PAM_AUTHTOK ye pam_gnome_keyring kana pam_kwallet5 zvichienderana nedesktop yako.

Tapedza! Ubuntu Hello yave kushanda pakombuta iyi. Edza kuita chero chinhu chaungawanzo nyora password yako kuti iite chokwadi, sekumhanyisa rairo ne sudo. Kana iwe wakagonesa keyring auto-unlock, kiyi yako yekupinda kana KWallet inozovhurwa otomatiki pakupinda.

Unogona kuvhura iyo Ubuntu Hello Configurator gare gare kuti uchinje mamwe magadzirirwo epamberi kana kuwedzera mamwe mamodheru. Dzvanya Pedzisa pazasi kuvhara iyi hwindo uye wovhura iyo Ubuntu Hello Configurator.
Ubuntu Hello inogona kuvhura otomatiki kiyi yako yekupinda kana KWallet uchishandisa humbowo hwechokwadi, kudzivirira password yekukurudzira mushure mekupinda mukati.

Nekuda kweshanduko mumakona, chinhambwe, uye zvimwe zvinhu kuenzaniswa kwechiso hakuna kumbobvira kwakafanana neyakachengetwa modhi yechiso. Pane ino peji unogona kuseta kuti Ubuntu Hello inofanira kuomesesa sei.

Zvichiri kukurumidza kuona,

Kukutendesa iwe Ubuntu Hello inoda kuchengetedza modhi yechiso chako kuti ikuzive. Dzvanya bhatani reScan pazasi kuti utange kutarisisa kumeso.

Ubuntu Hello ichatsvaga yako system otomatiki kune chero anowanikwa kamera, saka ita shuwa kuti webcam yako yakabatana. Mushure mekuona runyoro rwemawebcams anoshanda acharatidzwa. Sarudza yaunoda kushandisa uye tinya Next.
Ubuntu Hello inoda matatu akafanodzidziswa ekuziva kumeso dhata kuti akwanise kukuziva, ayo anozodhaunirodwa izvozvi. Unogona kuona kurodha kufambira mberi pazasi.
Iyi wizard inokufambisa iwe kuburikidza nekuseta uye kugadzirisa otomatiki Ubuntu Hello yako. Dzvanya inotevera kuti uenderere mberi.
